standard: CCSS HSF-TF.C.8: Prove the Pythagorean identity sin²(θ) + cos²(θ) = 1 and use it to find sin(θ), cos(θ), or tan(θ) given one of them and the quadrant of θ.
source: Original content written for Pip (no third-party text copied); aligned to CCSS HSF-TF.C.8.
attribution: Pip team, original. Common Core standards are cited for alignment only.
in_scope: squaring both ratios and adding them
out_of_scope: the identity for tangent and secant (next mission)

look_fors: Sine is opposite over hypotenuse and cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse

look_fors: Squares both ratios and adds them: (opp² + adj²) ÷ hyp²
Notices the top is the Pythagorean theorem, so it equals hyp² ÷ hyp², which is 1
